rules.title: 2026 Annual General Adjustment (AGA) Order – Rent Board Regulation 1148
rules.requirement: Eligible landlords may raise the 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than January 1, 2026. The AGA equals 65% of the Bay Area CPI increase from July 1, 2024 to June 30, 2025, and does not apply to tenancies that began on or after January 1, 2025 with rents set under Costa-Hawkins.
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Stabilization Board Regulation 1148; Berkeley Municipal Code section 13.76.110A
rules.quoted_span:
At its regular meeting on October 16, 2025, the Berkeley Rent Stabilization Board 
adopted the Annual General Adjustment (AGA) Order for Year 2026 which will allow 
eligible landlords to increase the 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than 
January 1, 2026.
rules.coverage_text: Eligible landlords' units subject to 2025 permanent rent ceilings; does not adjust rents of tenants whose tenancy began on or after January 1, 2025 and whose rents were set pursuant to the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act.
rules.exemptions: Tenancies that began on or after January 1, 2025 with rents set pursuant to the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act are not adjusted by the 2026 AGA.
rules.interaction: The notice references the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act for rents set on tenancies beginning on or after January 1, 2025, but does not state that this rule displaces any state rule.
rules.extraction_note: Eligibility conditions and required tenant notice are in Regulation 1148, which is not reproduced in this notice. The 65% of CPI formula was approved by voters in November 2004. The notice does not state which buildings are covered or any construction cutoff. Effective date is taken from 'no earlier than January 1, 2026'.
